verdict.rationale: A system-to-system filing channel is a fair question for an IP office, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows human-facing online requests (an online filing guide, online title issuance) and a 404 for llms.txt. Nothing documents system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers or an enrollment path for software clients.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
